headlines.title: How Gartner Recognition Will Impact Workday Stock Ahead Of Earnings
headlines.summary: Workday has been recognized in the past week as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises for the fifth straight year and is the only vendor labeled a Customers' Choice in Gartner Peer Insights for the same category.

headlines.title: Workday (WDAY), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
headlines.summary: Recognition from Gartner as a Leader and Customers' Choice in cloud ERP put fresh attention on Workday (WDAY). This industry endorsement gives investors another reference point as they assess the software group's valuation. The Gartner recognition comes during a mixed period for Workday. The share price is at US$201.84 after a 90 day share price return of 18.56%, which contrasts with a 1 year total shareholder return decline of 13.04%.

headlines.title: Workday Named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises for Fifth Consecutive Year
headlines.summary: Workday, Inc. (NASDAQ: WDAY), the trusted agentic platform for HR, finance, and IT, has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises for the fifth consecutive year. A complimentary copy of the report is available here.

headlines.title: Why Workday (WDAY) Outpaced the Stock Market Today
headlines.summary: The latest trading day saw Workday (WDAY) settling at $201.84, representing a +1.97% change from its previous close.

headlines.title: Chime Expands Partnership with Workday, Bringing Easier Access to Banking and Financial Wellness Benefits to Millions of Employees
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, November 03, 2026--Chime® (NASDAQ: CHYM) today announced an expanded partnership with Workday, the trusted agentic platform for HR, finance, and IT, making it easier for millions of employees to choose Chime for direct deposit within Workday — and connect their paycheck to tools that help them save, build credit and get ahead.

description: Workday, Inc. provides enterprise cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company offers a suite of financial management applications to maintain accounting information; manage financial processes, such as payables and receivables; identify real-time financial, operational, and management insights; perform financial consolidation; reduce time-to-close; promote internal control and auditability; and achieve consistency across finance operations. It also provides spend management solutions that help organizations to streamline supplier selection and contract management, build and execute sourcing events, such as requests for proposals, and manage indirect spend; expense management solutions to submit and approve expenses; and a suite of human capital management applications that enables HR teams to hire, onboard, pay, develop, reskill, and provide employee experiences. In addition, the company offers planning applications. Further, it provides supply chain and inventory solutions to healthcare organizations; solutions to manage the end-to-end student and faculty lifecycle; Workday Extend for customers and their developers to build custom applications. The company serves the professional and business services, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, media, education, government, technology, media, retail, and hospitality industries. It sells its solutions through its direct sales organization. The company was formerly known as North Tahoe Power Tools, Inc. and changed its name to Workday, Inc. in July 2005. Workday, Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, California.
